design_philosophy: A trustworthy, clean, and warm community aesthetic. Focus on high legibility, professional trust, and inviting action. Generous spacing on public pages to let emotional stories breathe, combined with high-density, crisp utility in the fundraiser and admin dashboards.

primary.description: Deep professional blue for trust, primary text, and headers (Tailwind blue-900).

secondary.description: Slate-900 for high-contrast deep text and secondary emphasis.

accent.description: Warm emerald green for 'Donate' buttons, progress bars, and primary CTAs (Tailwind emerald-600).

background.description: Clean whites (paper) and soft grays (slate-50) for maximum readability.

muted.description: Slate-100 for subtle card backgrounds and Slate-500 for secondary text.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-blue-900
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-blue-900

spacing_and_layout.general: Generous spacing philosophy (p-8 to p-12) for marketing pages to give breathing room. Admin/Dashboards use tighter grid gaps (gap-4 to gap-6).
spacing_and_layout.marketing_grid: Bento layout with asymmetrical column spans (e.g., col-span-full md:col-span-8 row-span-2) and wide gaps (gap-8).
spacing_and_layout.dashboard_grid: Control Room layout for admin and fundraiser dashboards. Dense grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4) with gap-6. Use h-full on children.
spacing_and_layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for main cards, rounded-xl for buttons, rounded-full for badges and tags.

surfaces_and_shadows.glassmorphism: Used for public sticky header: bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-slate-200/50 shadow-sm. Ensures optical clarity while remaining readable.
surfaces_and_shadows.cards: Used for campaigns and dashboard widgets: bg-white border border-slate-200 shadow-sm hover:shadow-md transition-shadow duration-200. Sharp 1px border to ground the soft shadow.
surfaces_and_shadows.progress_bars: bg-slate-100 rounded-full h-3 overflow-hidden. Fill is bg-emerald-500 with a subtle animated pulse effect.

buttons.primary: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors
buttons.secondary: bg-white border border-slate-200 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium rounded-xl px-6 py-3 transition-colors

components.inputs: Shadcn components heavily customized. border-slate-200 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-emerald-500/20 focus:border-emerald-500 rounded-xl bg-white
components.badges: inline-flex items-center px-3 py-1 rounded-full text-xs font-medium bg-slate-100 text-slate-800

motion_and_interaction.hover: Cards lift slightly (-translate-y-1) with increased shadow. Buttons transition background colors smoothly (duration-200).
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Staggered fade-in for campaign grids using Framer Motion.
motion_and_interaction.progress_animation: Progress bars load from 0 to target width on mount with an ease-out transition (duration-1000).

icons_and_assets.icon_library: lucide-react (default) for dashboard, line-style, clean strokes. Size 20px-24px for standard icons.
icons_and_assets.image_treatment: Images should have max-h-[80vh] on mobile. Overlay on hero image should be soft white gradient if needed, but prefer placing text on solid background next to images in light mode.

hero.description: Diverse community of people smiling, perfect for the public landing page hero section.

category_medical.description: Doctor and patient holding hands, representing the Medical crowdfunding category.

category_education.description: Students studying in a classroom, representing the Education crowdfunding category.

category_creative.description: Artist painting in a studio, representing the Creative crowdfunding category.

category_memorial.description: Candle lit in a dim setting, representing the Memorial crowdfunding category.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: All text must pass WCAG AA. Deep blue on white is >7:1. Emerald green on white is >3:1 (large text) or >4.5:1 (regular).
accessibility_and_testing.testing_attributes: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='donate-button-paypal', data-testid='campaign-progress-bar').

instructions_to_main_agent: Install the required fonts: Outfit and DM Sans via Google Fonts.
Setup Tailwind configuration to include the custom colors (primary: deep blue, accent: emerald, etc.) and fonts.
Build the public landing page with a clean, light-mode Bento grid layout and use the provided media URLs for categories and hero.
Implement the Campaign details page ensuring the progress bar uses the accent color and has a clear 'Donate via PayPal' CTA.
Build the dashboards (Fundraiser and Admin) using Shadcn components, prioritizing data density and functional clarity with 'Control Room' grid layout.
Always apply `data-testid` to all forms, buttons, links, and important data readouts.
